page_title: DOR 3-1 EIN | Dortmund v Eintracht Frankfurt 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Tobias Stieler is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Eintracht Frankfurt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+5' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) accepted an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashed a decent strike towards the top right corner of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, was alert and thwarted the effort. The referee signals a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
90+3' 3 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Emre Can (Dortmund) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Kevin Trapp no chance!
90+2' Emre Can (Dortmund) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+1' Tobias Stieler shows the yellow card to Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) for a heavy challenge.
90+1' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! That is a penalty kick for Dortmund.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The game has come to an end for Ellyes Skhiri. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Makoto Hasebe (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90' It is time for a substitution. Timothy Chandler (Eintracht Frankfurt) is on for Tuta.
87' Confusion here but it seems that referee Tobias Stieler has changed his mind following the VAR review and downgraded the red card shown to Emre Can (Dortmund) to a yellow.

86' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Emre Can (Dortmund), but referee Tobias Stieler must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!

85' It's a foul from Emre Can (Dortmund). Surprisingly, the referee comes and pulls out a red card. It was a very harsh one and Emre Can (Dortmund) complains, but it's no use of course. The decision has been made.
85' Edin Terzic has decided to make a change. Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) replaces Julian Brandt.
85' Substitution. Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ian Maatsen walks off.

81' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Julian Brandt flights in the free kick and the ball finds the head of Mats Hummels (Dortmund), whose excellent bullet header from the centre of the box goes into the right side of the goal. 2:1.
81' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) will miss the next game.
80' Tobias Stieler shows a yellow card to Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) for a tough tackle.
79' The corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is hurriedly cleared.
76' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Dortmund.

75' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
74' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Mario Gotze will be replaced by Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt).
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) for Ansgar Knauff.
73' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
73' Substitution. Niclas Fullkrug walks off the pitch and Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) comes on as a substitute.
72' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.

71' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
69' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out.
66' That will be all from Junior Dina Ebimbe who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
66' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
65' Edin Terzic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) replacing Karim Adeyemi.
65' Substitution. Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) on for Marco Reus.
61' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
61' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
60' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Dortmund will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
58' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Dortmund will have an opportunity.
56' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
52' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

50' The opposition back off Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the top right corner, but Alexander Meyer denies him with the save.
48' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle and it's Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Eintracht Frankfurt have a free kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is caught offside yet again.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 66:34.
40' An attempted cross from Donyell Malen (Dortmund) is cleared.
37' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
36' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

36' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

35' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Emre Can (Dortmund). Tobias Stieler saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt in a dangerous position.
33' 1 - 1 Goal! Donyell Malen puts the ball on a plate for Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 1:1.
29' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

28' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
28' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
27' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
26' Dortmund seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
24' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
21' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
21' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
20' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Stieler has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Dortmund have a free kick.
19' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner which is cleared.

18' A huge opportunity wasted! Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) produces a header from a rebound around the penalty spot. His effort is denied by one of the defenders who is well positioned and clears the ball to safety. Dortmund force their opponents to concede a corner.

18' Marco Reus (Dortmund) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Kevin Trapp to get hold of the ball.
17' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
17' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund). Dortmund force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
13' What a sweet touch by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Alexander Meyer to hold.

13' 0 - 1 Goal! Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Alexander Meyer is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 0:1.

11' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
10' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

9' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.

7' Close effort! Marco Reus (Dortmund) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
7' The free kick will be taken by Marco Reus (Dortmund).

6' The game is interrupted. Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Dortmund will take a free kick.

4' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
3' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) tries to find Julian Brandt, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
2' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Dortmund will have the kick-off.
Tobias Stieler is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
